claude.reason: The clause is an existence test on tm_q05, the metric named in the `scales` block as `primary_metric_best`, and it closes the family only if NO (symbol, stride, horizon) cell reaches above 1.0. Four symbols report a cell above that threshold: ETHUSDT at 3.6056116382051298, BTCUSDT at 2.051039115127731, SOLUSDT at 1.6619021758095884 and BNBUSDT at 1.1260625166054576. One such cell is enough to falsify 'no cell', so the clause as written does not apply and there is no other clause in the kill condition. Note separately, and without treating it as a ground for closing: the surface is ranked on mwrr_q05, whose best values are negative on five of nine symbols (ADAUSDT -0.31971005364131944, AVAXUSDT -0.2985760826081987, LTCUSDT -0.23739920078441465, DOGEUSDT -0.0988066126163582, XRPUSDT -0.05335045602927216); the shape diagnostic reads SPIKE on all five symbols where it is measurable (BNBUSDT plateau_ratio -5.488498827971867, BTCUSDT -1.95256212525742, ETHUSDT -1.011937585161423, SOLUSDT -2.0691822590730427); the search test returns INDISTINGUISHABLE_FROM_SEARCH on both symbols where it ran (ETHUSDT p=0.725, SOLUSDT p=0.79); PBO is uncomputable on all three attempted symbols for want of two configurations sharing a horizon; and independent_paths_best is between 1.02 and 1.40 everywhere. The two winning tm_q05 cells above 2.0 both sit at stride_days=30.0, an axis level that is NaN in almost every other cell, so the threshold is cleared by the least-replicated corner of the grid. None of that is in the pre-registered condition, so it is CONTINUE plus this reservation, not a close.

codex.clause: Closed if no (symbol, stride, horizon) cell reaches a 5th-percentile terminal multiple above 1.0 across start dates.
codex.reason: The clause requires that no cell have tm_q05 above 1.0. That is false: BNBUSDT reaches 1.1260625166054576, BTCUSDT 2.051039115127731, ETHUSDT 3.6056116382051298, and SOLUSDT 1.6619021758095884. Therefore the sole kill clause is not met.
